literalSpacetime.meaning: Spin(2,3) acts on a five-dimensional metric with two physical timelike directions.
literalSpacetime.minimalTest: A free scalar Fourier mode with nonzero second-time frequency has m_eff^2 = m^2 - omega_2^2.
literalSpacetime.scope: This rejects the unconstrained literal realization, not every possible constrained two-time theory.
literalSpacetime.repairBurden: Supply a closed first-class constraint or gauge symmetry that removes every physical second-time momentum mode and then prove positive cohomology and a well-posed 3+1 initial-value problem.

responseGeometry.meaning: Spin0(2,3) is the conformal completion of the positive H2(R) response cone.
responseGeometry.minimalTest: No second spacetime time or additional propagating coordinate is introduced.
responseGeometry.scope: This does not certify the microscopic four-dimensional action; it only prevents ambient response geometry from being misread as an extra physical time.

informationDeficit.reason: The action is a typed term inventory, not a gauge-fixed quadratic functional with numerical coefficients, a selected vacuum, a constraint complex, and operator domains.
missing: metric and kinetic-sign convention applied consistently to every term
numerical gauge couplings and kinetic-mixing coefficient
complete scalar/projector potential and a stationary vacuum
quadratic fluctuation operator including gauge fixing
BRST differential or Dirac first-class and second-class constraint algebra
boundary conditions and the domain of each kinetic operator
dynamical-gravity action and sign, if the metric is not merely a source

witnessPair.sharedDeclaredForm: In the normalization -B_Y^2/(4gY^2)-f_X^2/(4eX^2)-chi f_X B_Y/2, K = [[1/gY^2, chi], [chi, 1/eX^2]] for the two Abelian field strengths.
witnessPair.conclusion: Both instantiate the displayed term inventory, so that inventory alone cannot decide A4.

domainWitness.positiveDomain: Dirichlet boundary data has nonnegative spectrum.
domainWitness.negativeDomain: The self-adjoint Robin condition psi'(0)=-kappa psi(0), kappa>0, admits psi=exp(-kappa x) with eigenvalue -kappa^2.
domainWitness.conclusion: A differential expression, and even self-adjointness alone, does not determine positivity without the boundary domain.

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: Use the ordinary BRST-positive Standard Model as an input baseline; it is not rederived by S_v1.
conditions: standard gauge fixing and BRST cohomology

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: The real symmetric kinetic matrix must be positive definite.
maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.falsifier: A nonpositive eigenvalue after kinetic diagonalization.

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: For V=-mu_s^2 |s|^2 + lambda_s |s|^4 and s=(v+rho)e^{i theta}/sqrt(2), the broken vacuum has v^2=mu_s^2/lambda_s and m_rho^2=2 mu_s^2.
maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.falsifier: No stationary broken vacuum or a negative radial Hessian eigenvalue.

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: The sigma-model tangent metric is positive when fP^2>0, but masses are eigenvalues of the unspecified cross-Peirce Hessian of V_resp.
conditions: positive-semidefinite constrained Hessian at the chosen projector vacuum
maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.falsifier: A negative constrained Hessian eigenvalue or a wrong-sign tangent kinetic term.

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: Pure compact BF theory has no local propagating bulk modes, so it has no perturbative bulk kinetic ghost to count.
conditions: a boundary variational principle and Hilbert-space star structure
maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.falsifier: An induced boundary mode with negative norm or Hamiltonian unbounded below.

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: Level three gives the claimed finite topological state count on spatial T2 only after the compact reduction; positivity still requires the boundary/domain and star-structure data.
maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.falsifier: Failure of gauge invariance, a nonunitary mapping-class action, or a negative-norm boundary state.

maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.test: A positive conserved spectral kernel yields a positive two-probe response.
maximalDeclaredQuadraticSubsector.falsifier: A negative eigenvalue of the physical response beyond subtraction and numerical uncertainty.

gateVerdict.notFailedBecause: The declared 4D EFT has a nonempty parameter region compatible with positive quadratic kinetic terms.
gateVerdict.notPassedBecause: The candidate does not select that region or provide the full gauge-fixed Hessian, physical cohomology, boundary domains, and pole-residue audit.
minimumRepair: Declare that H2(R)/Spin0(2,3) is response geometry rather than a second-time spacetime.
Choose a vacuum and publish the complete quadratic action with all coefficients and sign conventions.
Impose and verify the Abelian kinetic-matrix inequalities.
Provide BRST or Dirac cohomology and count physical modes.
Specify boundary operator domains and prove self-adjointness plus lower-bounded energy.
Check every gauge-invariant propagator pole for nonnegative mass squared and positive residue.
gateVerdict.minimalStopEverythingFalsifier: One gauge-invariant physical pole with negative residue, one unavoidable negative-norm cohomology class, or one physical second-time Fourier mode with omega_2^2>m^2 and no gauge constraint removing it.
